finalText:
**Build's clean.** Exit 0, 0 errors.

The bump changed two call sites the migration missed.

- [options.js:7](src/core/options.js:7) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to match.
- [retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8) threw on `undefined` flags. New config loader leaves unset flags undefined instead of `false`, so added that case, treated as disabled.

The remaining 8 warnings are just deprecation noise from the bump, not real bugs. Nothing else to do.
